requirements.description: The system shall ingest handwritten, image, spreadsheet, and PDF inputs, automatically parse supported files, and convert recognized formulas or tables into normalized LaTeX code.

The system shall support user registration, login/authentication, password recovery, and user account information management, including credential validation and failure feedback for invalid login attempts.
The system shall manage projects and collaboration groups, including creation, browsing, joining, member management, shared resources, and role-based access for owners and collaborators.
The system shall manage a version tree for project history, including historical version lookup, child-version creation, file editing, restoration, download, and version comments.

The system shall allow users to edit generated LaTeX content, render a real-time preview, and export outputs as PDF, LaTeX source, PNG, or JPEG artifacts, with compatibility to mainstream LaTeX workflows.
The system shall persist and retrieve user, group, project, version, file-path, parsed-content, workspace, edit-time, and comment data according to the database schema constraints.
The system shall provide browser-based user interfaces for the main workflows and support modern browsers, including WebSocket-capable clients for real-time web interaction.

The system shall expose external HTTP/REST APIs for user, project, file, collaboration, preview, version, and comment operations, and define internal service interfaces for verification, storage, recognition, LaTeX generation, rendering, collaboration, and version control.
The system shall protect sensitive data and defend relevant web inputs against common attacks, including encryption-related privacy handling and protections against SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF.

components.name: Web Client Application
components.description: Browser-based SPA providing user interface workflows, editor interaction, real-time preview rendering, and WebSocket client support.

components.name: API & Security Gateway
components.description: Exposes external HTTP/REST and WebSocket endpoints, handles routing, rate-limiting, and enforces security defenses (SQLi, XSS, CSRF filtering and SSL/TLS termination).

components.name: Authentication and Account Service
components.description: Manages user registration, credential validation, sessions/tokens, password recovery, and account data encryption.

components.name: Project & Collaboration Service
components.description: Handles project lifecycle, workspace state, collaboration groups, and role-based access control (RBAC).

components.name: Version Control Service
components.description: Manages project version trees, child-version branching, restoration points, file revisions, and version comments.

components.name: Document Ingestion & Recognition Service
components.description: Ingests handwritten notes, images, PDFs, and spreadsheets; parses structures and generates normalized LaTeX code.

components.name: LaTeX Rendering & Export Engine
components.description: Performs real-time LaTeX preview rendering, validation, and multi-format export generation (PDF, source, PNG, JPEG).

components.name: Data Persistence Layer
components.description: Persists relational schema entities, version trees, audit logs, and file metadata with encrypted storage constraints.

connectors.description: Transfers client API calls and real-time bidirectional WebSocket events.
Routes authentication, password recovery, and identity verification requests.
Routes project management and collaborative session requests.
Routes version lookup, tree traversal, commit, and restore commands.
Dispatches uploaded files for ingestion, parsing, and LaTeX conversion.
Dispatches rendering and export transformation tasks.
Reads and writes user credentials and profile records.
Manages persistence of projects, group memberships, and role assignments.
Stores and queries version tree nodes, snapshots, and file references.
Stores uploaded assets, parsed raw data, and normalized LaTeX definitions.
Coordinates workspace edit states with project version tree revisions.
